Net farm rental income or (loss). Subtract line 31 from line 7. If the result is income, enter it here and on Schedule E (Form 1040), line 40. If the result is a loss, you must go to line 34. See instructions
If line 32 is a loss, check the box that describes your investment in this activity. See instructions: 34a All investment is at risk. 34b Some investment is not at risk.

You may have to complete Form 8582 to determine your deductible loss, regardless of which box you checked. If you checked box 34b, you must complete Form 6198 before going to Form 8582. In either case, enter the deductible loss here and on Schedule E (Form 1040), line 40. See instructions
